en.title: Kit Harington Tackles Dickens as 'A Tale of Two Cities' Arrives
en.summary: This Sunday brings a fresh adaptation of a literary classic, starring a familiar face from Westeros. Get ready for high drama and Victorian intrigue.
en.body:
This Sunday, television offers a compelling blend of classic literature and returning fan favorites. At the forefront is a brand-new adaptation of Charles Dickens' monumental novel, **A Tale of Two Cities**, featuring **Kit Harington** in a leading role. Known globally for his portrayal of Jon Snow in **Game of Thrones**, Harington steps into a very different world, one of revolutionary France and intricate personal drama. This adaptation promises to bring the timeless story of sacrifice, resurrection, and the stark contrast between two cities to a new generation of viewers, all through the lens of Harington's proven dramatic talent.

The literary titan Charles Dickens penned **A Tale of Two Cities** in 1859, and its narrative, set against the backdrop of the French Revolution, has resonated for over a century. The story famously begins, "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times," a duality that defines its characters and their tumultuous journeys. The novel explores themes of social injustice, love, and redemption, making it fertile ground for television adaptation. This latest iteration, starring Harington, is poised to capture the sweeping scope and emotional depth that has made the book a perennial favorite, offering a chance to see a beloved actor inhabit a complex, iconic character.

## Fan Favorites Make Their Return

Beyond the classic adaptation, Sunday also marks the highly anticipated return of **The Marlow Murder Club** for its third season. This beloved mystery series, known for its charming characters and clever whodunits, continues to captivate audiences. Fans have eagerly awaited the next installment, eager to rejoin the titular club and unravel new enigmas. The show has cultivated a dedicated following, drawn to its blend of cozy mystery and sharp wit. Its return is a significant event for those who have followed the detectives' previous cases, promising more intrigue and satisfying resolutions.

Adding to the Sunday night lineup, **The Walking Dead: Dead City** sees Maggie Rhee, portrayed by **Lauren Cohan**, facing critical choices. As the series continues its post-apocalyptic journey, Maggie's resolve and survival instincts will be put to the ultimate test. The spin-off has explored new territories and character dynamics within the **Walking Dead** universe, and this upcoming episode appears to be a pivotal moment for her storyline, raising the stakes for both her and her companions in the desolate landscape of a ravaged New York City.

## What to Expect This Week

With a new Dickensian epic starring **Kit Harington** and the continued adventures of fan-favorite detectives and survivors, Sunday promises a rich viewing experience. The return of **The Marlow Murder Club** and the high-stakes drama in **The Walking Dead: Dead City** ensure that there's something for every genre fan. These offerings highlight the strength of current television programming, blending literary adaptation with established, beloved series.

## What's Next

Tune in this Sunday for the premiere of the new **A Tale of Two Cities** adaptation and the Season 3 launch of **The Marlow Murder Club**. Additionally, catch the latest developments in **The Walking Dead: Dead City** as Maggie navigates further peril.
